# Teaching {.teaching-page-title}

## Statistical training that connects theory, computation, and scientific application.

::: teaching-intro-text
<p>My teaching emphasizes the connection between statistical theory and the computational tools needed to apply that theory to modern scientific problems. Across methodological and applied courses, I aim to develop both statistical understanding and the ability to translate that understanding into reproducible analysis.</p>
:::
::::

Computational methods and tools for modern statistical research, with an emphasis on implementation, reproducibility, and efficient statistical programming.

::: course-meta

### Spatial & Spatiotemporal Modeling with Applications

Statistical modeling for spatially and temporally structured data, connecting Gaussian-process methodology with practical analysis and computation.

::: course-meta
Drexel University · 2024

### Generalized Linear Models

Theory and application of generalized linear models, with emphasis on statistical inference, model formulation, diagnostics, and implementation.

::: course-meta
Drexel University · 2025–present

### Statistical Inference I

Foundations of statistical inference, including likelihood-based methods, estimation, hypothesis testing, and theoretical properties of statistical procedures.

::: course-meta
Drexel University · 2026

## Workshops & Specialized Instruction {.teaching-section-title}

:::: teaching-feature
### Spatial & Spatiotemporal Modeling with Applications in R

**Urban Health Collaborative Summer Workshop**

An applied introduction to spatial and spatiotemporal data analysis using R, designed to connect statistical methodology with substantive problems in public health and related fields.

::: course-meta
Drexel University · 2024–present
:::
::::

:::: teaching-feature
### Statistical Inference I & II — Ph.D. Qualifying Examination Preparation

A twelve-week review covering core material in statistical inference and preparation for the doctoral qualifying examination.

::: course-meta
Drexel University · 2024–present
:::
